title: OneOnOne
$comment: Describes the YAML frontmatter of a data/1on1/*.md file. The Markdown body below the frontmatter holds freeform discussion notes and is not validated here. Informal/lightweight for MVP — not enforced yet, just a shared reference for the Skill and dashboard parser.

id.description: Unique identifier for this 1:1, e.g. "1on1-2026-07-20". Used by IDPAction.linked_evidence and other references.

date.description: Date the 1:1 took place (or is scheduled to take place), YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: "draft" while this file is a prep note for an upcoming 1:1 that hasn't happened yet; flipped to "logged" once the meeting happens and real notes are added. Replaces the earlier separate NextMeetingDraft concept — there is only ever one file per 1:1.

attendees.description: Names/handles of people present (e.g. employee, manager).

follow_ups.description: Short freeform action items or things to revisit next time. Distinct from formal IDPAction entries — promote to an IDPAction if it warrants tracking with dates/status.

linked_actions.description: IDs of IDPAction entries discussed or affected by this 1:1, e.g. "idp-2026-001" (referential integrity checked later, not at MVP stage).
